nodes.name: Provider adapter
nodes.notes: If IMAGE_PROVIDER_STATUS is not exactly CONFIGURED, we hold the item at image generation and NEVER fabricate an output. The downstream derivative + WP upload steps are skipped; the editorial item remains at waiting_human_review for the operator to handle images manually.

nodes.name: POST image provider
nodes.notes: Vendor-agnostic HTTP call. Provider credentials live in n8n credentials; never serialized into workflow JSON.

nodes.name: POST /api/automation/rights-check
nodes.notes: Server-side rights check. If provider_status is NOT_CONFIGURED or asset is missing, the route returns rights_state=manual_review and holds the item.
